root: ^It worked! I was right! I am still the smartest fish around!
^I’m the one that made the scissors…but okay, sure.
^I have already figured out the next task.
^It should be on your stone now.
^What??  I only just finished this task, can’t a cat have a nap??
^Good. Unless there’s anything else, you can leave.
^Actually, there is. Do you…do you believe in gods? Like Eleni does?
^Oh. I’m not sure I like this question.
^I know some humans believe in some big guy up in the sky, but I mean do you believe in something...more?
^I believe everything can be explained with logic and reason.
^I believe in things around a higher power but, do I believe in a higher power? No, I don’t.
^I don’t know...I’m still figuring it out.
^But I think maybe everything happens for a reason...the things that happen to us...the people we meet.
^There could be some sort of spirit or being making it all happen.
^That’s what Eleni believes, but maybe she’s wrong.
^sigh* I have worked my entire life to understand the world around us. I don’t have all the answers.
^If I did, I’d stop and spend the rest of my days relaxing in the Red Sea.
^But I know I can never stop, because we will never know everything.
^If that’s how you feel then why do you want to help her?
^Eleni is different…maybe other humans are too.
^And if I don’t help her, she could lose faith in the world and become like the rest of them.
^I will bring her guitar back to her.
